item.title: Five injured in thwarted potential major attack at Israeli checkpoint
item.description: Five people were injured in a shooting at an Israeli military checkpoint in the West Bank, prompting Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to close off the area.

item.title: Meghan distressed as father faces child abuse material investigation
item.description: Thomas Markle, Meghan's estranged father, is under investigation in the Philippines for alleged possession of child abuse material.

item.title: Trump backs Ramaswamy ad as top Republicans urge its removal
item.description: Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine and Iowa Republican Senate candidate Rep. Ashley Hinson both said the campaign should stop airing the ad.

item.title: Woman completes historic swim along entire California coast
item.description: ABC News' Danny New speaks with Catherine Breed, who swam the nearly 900-mile route in just 111 days, making history.
